correctness.rationale: The original eight-neighbor Day & Night rule gives the exact local equivalence of every-cell inversion and all cyclic triple-column sums in {3,6}. The weighted sixteen-state transfer counts all row patterns. Newton identities reconstruct the exact factored characteristic polynomial using integer calculations, implying the all-n trace formula and the exact primitive orbit count. Independent full-cell enumeration for n=3..7 confirms its definitions and counts; finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.
